description: A single rendered panel (no lettered sub-panels) that appears to be a finite-element/simulation contour plot of a deformed sample. The only printed text is "Pass 1" at the top left. At the bottom right is a coordinate triad: a red arrow labelled X, a green arrow labelled Y, and a small blue element labelled Z (bold letters X, Y, Z above the arrowheads). The body of the image consists of two adjacent, strongly sheared parallelogram (oblique rhomboid) outlines, each filled with smooth banded contour shading in several tones of blue. In both shapes a large light-blue diagonal band runs through the interior, bordered by darker blue zones that follow the long edges and the tapered corners, suggesting a graded field with an interior maximum. No colour bar, no legend, no numerical ticks, no axis scale and no scale bar are present anywhere in the image, so neither the physical quantity being contoured nor its unit can be read from the pixels. The geometry (a rhomboid sheared from a cubic/cylindrical billet) is consistent with the sample after one multiaxial forging pass; whether the two shapes are two views or two overlapping stage outlines is not indicated.

subfigures.description: Left sheared parallelogram body filled with banded blue contour shading; a broad light-blue band runs diagonally through the interior, flanked by darker blue along the long edges and pointed corners. No legend or scale.
Right sheared parallelogram body, slightly wider and with a more pronounced light-blue interior core and dark blue margins; same oblique rhomboid outline as the left shape. No legend or scale.
Bottom-right orientation marker: red X arrow, green Y arrow, blue Z element with bold letters X, Y, Z.

observations.observation: The only text printed inside the image is "Pass 1", located at the top-left.
A coordinate triad at the bottom right labels the axes X (red arrow), Y (green arrow) and Z (blue element).
Two adjacent oblique parallelogram (sheared rhomboid) bodies are shown, each filled with smooth banded contour shading in several shades of blue.
In both shapes a large light-blue band occupies the interior and darker blue zones follow the long edges and pointed corners, indicating a graded field with an interior maximum.
No colour bar, legend, numeric axis ticks, gridlines or scale bar appear in the image, so the contoured quantity and its unit cannot be identified from the pixels.
The image contains no visible label stating whether the two parallelogram shapes are two views of one sample or two distinct stages/outlines.
No caption was extracted for this figure, so nothing about the plot's quantity, loading direction or colour-scale range is supplied textually.

The paper abstract states that the processed sample conditions are 0 pass, 1 pass, 3 pass and 5 pass with 33% normal strain in each pass, characterised by XRD and EBSD; the label "Pass 1" therefore denotes the single-pass MAF sample.
The paper is about an Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel deformed by warm multiaxial forging, which is the material context of the "Pass 1" label.
